entities.summary: Prince William Charles Christian of Saxe-Gotha-Altenburg was a German prince of the Saxe-Gotha-Altenburg house, a junior line of the Ernestine Wettins. He served as a Generalfeldzeugmeister in the armies of the Holy Roman Empire.
